disclaimer.title: Before you use NutriDex
disclaimer.intro: Please read this. It appears the first time you open the app and again after each update.

sections.heading: This is not medical advice
sections.body: NutriDex is for general information and learning. It does not diagnose, treat, cure or prevent any disease, and it does not replace advice from a doctor, registered dietitian or pharmacist. Don't start, stop or change a medication, supplement or diet because of something you read here without asking one of them first.

sections.heading: Medications, pregnancy and health conditions
sections.body: Some foods and supplements interact with medications: vitamin K, for example, works against the blood thinner warfarin. Others matter more if you are pregnant or breastfeeding, have kidney disease, or have allergies. If any of that applies to you, check with your clinician before acting on anything here.

sections.heading: Supplements
sections.body: NutriDex shows what supplement labels say and flags amounts above published upper limits. It never recommends a dose. The FDA does not approve dietary supplements before they are sold, so a label is the maker's claim, not a verified fact.

sections.heading: How accurate the data is
sections.body: Nutrient amounts come from USDA FoodData Central and are averages; the food in front of you will differ. Every effect carries an evidence grade, from A (consistent human trials) to D (traditional or anecdotal use), and many findings are early. Missing data is shown as missing, never guessed. The information can be incomplete or out of date.

sections.heading: Emergencies
sections.body: NutriDex is not for emergencies. If you think you or someone else is having a medical emergency, call 911 or your local emergency number. For a possible poisoning or overdose, call Poison Control at 1-800-222-1222.

sections.heading: No warranty
sections.body: NutriDex is provided as is, without warranties of any kind. You use it at your own risk, and its maker is not liable for decisions you make based on it.

sections.heading: What is stored about you
sections.body: Nothing, except a setting on this device that remembers which version of this notice you accepted, so it only appears again after an update.
